policy: Behavior-based regression specifications using synthetic fixtures. Automated references cover only their stated scope; unimplemented cases are not passing tests.

cases.environment: Disposable WordPress installation with synthetic content and identities; use controlled SDK/service fixtures where required.
cases.given: Configure a multisite subsite with Prepublish enabled. Grant a network Super Admin no explicit subsite membership. Add a custom Custom Editor with edit_posts and a custom read-only role.
cases.when: Sign in separately as Editor, custom editor, and Super Admin; open a private subsite preview and start Prepublish. Repeat as the read-only role.
cases.then: Authorized editors see the overlay and capture the draft; no explicit membership is required for Super Admin. Read-only users cannot read the draft or load the frontend overlay.

automated.match: ${role} captures a subsite draft without a role-name allowlist
automated.scope: Real WordPress capabilities, multisite membership, frontend script, toolbar and draft callback; SDK queue substituted.

cases.remaining: Validate the complete scenario with the actual SDK and controlled services; automated references cover only the stated scope.

cases.environment: Disposable WordPress installation with synthetic content and identities; use controlled SDK/service fixtures where required.
cases.given: Use a controlled subscription/policy service fixture with QA and accessibility completing promptly and a delayed Policy response. Repeat with zero integration-visible policies and with several eligible policies.
cases.when: Run an initial check, a second check and a same-page recheck, then exercise cancellation and a Policy request that never completes.
cases.then: Only entitled checks and eligible policies run; completed results remain available. A delayed or failed Policy request terminates or reports a recoverable error within the service's documented deadline; cancellation releases the UI. Record per-check durations and request counts.
cases.remaining: Specification only. Requires a dedicated disposable environment and controlled dependencies before automation.

cases.environment: Disposable WordPress installation with synthetic content and identities; use controlled SDK/service fixtures where required.
cases.given: A WordPress draft differs from its published delivery URL. Configure Public URL to another origin and a current preview nonce; use Content-site access as the positive SSO control and Analytics-only access as the negative control.
cases.when: Open the draft and run Prepublish through both toolbar and callback. Repeat with DENY/CSP and a cross-origin redirect.
cases.then: Capture reads the local authenticated draft and reports its mapped public URL. Blocked capture submits nothing and removes its frame and loading UI. With Content access, the SSO session opens the report; Analytics-only access must not grant Content access.

automated.match: split-domain preview
automated.scope: Real browser cross-origin capture, nonce and public URL contract; companion failure cases cover frame restrictions.

automated.match: Prepublish captures
automated.scope: Actual WordPress drafts and autosaves; service is mocked.
